patch.value:
metadata = inflight_prediction_metadata[branch_id % num_inflight_branches]
ut_idx0 = hash(PC) % ut0_entries
ut_idx1 = hash(PC) % ut1_entries
ut_idx2 = hash(PC) % ut2_entries
wt_max = (1 << (wt_weight_bits - 1)) - 1
wt_min = -(1 << (wt_weight_bits - 1))
ut_max = (1 << (ut_weight_bits - 1)) - 1
ut_min = -(1 << (ut_weight_bits - 1))

for b in 0 .. num_banks - 1:
  # Update Prediction Tables (WT)
  best_r = metadata["best_r_per_bank"][b]
  if best_r != -1 and sc_update_needed:
    digest = metadata["digest_per_bank"][b]
    h0 = hash0(PC, digest) % wt0_entries
    h1 = hash1(PC, digest) % wt1_entries
    h2 = hash2(PC, digest) % wt2_entries
    if outcome == TAKEN:
      wt0[b][h0] = min(wt0[b][h0] + 1, wt_max)
      wt1[b][h1] = min(wt1[b][h1] + 1, wt_max)
      wt2[b][h2] = min(wt2[b][h2] + 1, wt_max)
    else:
      wt0[b][h0] = max(wt0[b][h0] - 1, wt_min)
      wt1[b][h1] = max(wt1[b][h1] - 1, wt_min)
      wt2[b][h2] = max(wt2[b][h2] - 1, wt_min)
  
  # Update Usefulness Tables (UT)
  available_in_bank = []
  for r in 0 .. num_logical_regs - 1:
    if (r % num_banks) == b and (metadata["available_mask"] & (1 << r)):
      available_in_bank = available_in_bank + [r]
  
  if len(available_in_bank) > 0 and sc_update_needed:
    rand_r = random_choice(available_in_bank)
    if was_bank_useful(b, outcome):
      ut0[ut_idx0][rand_r] = min(ut0[ut_idx0][rand_r] + 1, ut_max)
      ut1[ut_idx1][rand_r] = min(ut1[ut_idx1][rand_r] + 1, ut_max)
      ut2[ut_idx2][rand_r] = min(ut2[ut_idx2][rand_r] + 1, ut_max)
    else:
      ut0[ut_idx0][rand_r] = max(ut0[ut_idx0][rand_r] - 1, ut_min)
      ut1[ut_idx1][rand_r] = max(ut1[ut_idx1][rand_r] - 1, ut_min)
      ut2[ut_idx2][rand_r] = max(ut2[ut_idx2][rand_r] - 1, ut_min)

patch.value: Captures correlations between register values and branch directions by feeding digests of recently produced register values into the statistical corrector (SC). A Tomasulo-like table tracks valid register values, generating a 12-bit digest from integers, floats, or condition-code flags. At prediction time, for each of the 8 banks, the register with the highest usefulness score is chosen, and its digest is used to look up prediction weights which are summed into the overall SC prediction.
